title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - GaussianDataPoint
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/GaussianDataPoint. A data point whose quantity is a standard deviation. Subclass of DataPoint per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataPoint model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GaussianDataPoint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasStandardDeviation.description: Property. The standard deviation (i.e. the square root of the average of the squared deviations of the values subtracted from their average value) can be described with this property.
